# CommCare

CommCare is a mobile data collection and case management platform for health and social programs

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/commcare/.

## Actions

- **Create Lookup Table**: Create a new lookup table in a CommCare domain.
- **Create Web User Invitation**: Create an invitation for a new web user in CommCare.
- **List Reports** (read-only): Retrieve available reports configured in a CommCare project.
- **Single Sign On** (read-only): Validate login credentials and retrieve user profile for a mobile worker or web user.
- **Submit Form ODK Compatible**: Submit form data using ODK-compatible endpoint for Android client compatibility.
- **Submit Form to CommCare**: Submit an XForm to CommCare following the OpenRosa standard.
